$comment: Creatures (docs/adr/0073-creatures.md, CHARACTERS.md §11.6): animals as light server entities that wander, spawned near players by `rules` and removed far from all of them. A creature: its skinned `model` (shared/models/models.json), its walking speed (m/s), how far it wanders per walk (`wanderM`), how long it idles between walks (`idleSeconds` [min, max]), how many rows tall it is (`rows`: the open cells it needs over its ground), and the most rows it steps up (`climbRows`) or down (`dropRows`) in one step: a steeper edge (a cliff) or water stops it. A creature's body to a weapon (WORK_QUEUE item 35): its `health` (none or 0: it can't be hurt; a sword's hit takes its `weapon.damage`, shared/tools), `hitRadiusM` the radius round its body a swing's arc must come within to hit it, and `drops` what it leaves when killed (`item`, `count` n or [min, max]). `bodyRadiusM` (default 0.3) is its body's radius on the ground (BUGS.md #80, #81): its walk keeps that radius out of the solid cells round its column higher than it can climb (a wall), sliding along a wall it walks into slanting, and two creatures' bodies never overlap. How a hurt one reacts (flees, fights) is its species' `near.hurt` (shared/ecology). `hurtLook` (the file's, each creature's own overriding it field by field; WORK_QUEUE item 35) is how a hit that connects shows on the clients: for `seconds` its body flashes `tint` at up to `strength` (fading) and flinches `flinchM` away from the blow and `flinchDeg` round, easing back. Its `attack` (optional; WORK_QUEUE item 35: wolves bite) is how it hurts the player that struck it: for `angryS` after that player's last hit, while that player stands within `reachM` of its body and within `frontDeg` in front of it, every `cooldownS` it takes `damage` health (cause `Weapon`, through the damage rules: none in creative) and pushes the player away at `knockbackMps` and up at `liftMps`; a player at 0 health is defeated and kneels (CHARACTERS.md §11.13), never killed. Only the striker is bitten, and a weapon still strikes animals only (no PvP). A rule: the `creature`, the full blocks its ground may be (`on`), the share of the chunk columns near players that get a group (`chance`, rolled once per chunk column and face from the world seed: the same chunk always rolls the same), and the group's size (`group` [min, max]); `mix` (optional) lists other creatures a group may hold, each part rolled once a group with its `chance` and putting up to `max` of that creature in place of the rule's own (the deer: herds of does, sometimes with one stag). `limits`: chunks around each player that spawn (`spawnChunks`), the distance past which a creature with no player near is removed (`despawnM`), and the most in the world (`max`); `gapM` (default 0.2) the space creatures steer to keep between their bodies, at up to `pushMps` (default 1) m/s, a body overlapping another pushed straight out. An NPC (WORK_QUEUE item 38, CHARACTERS.md §11.11) is a creature with an `npc` block: `lookAtM` (it turns, at `turnDegPerS`, to face a player that near while idling), `bumpM` and `sidestepM` (a player or NPC that near makes it step that far aside), `idles` (the idle poses it picks by `weight`: stand, look around or sit, each for `seconds` [min, max], in place of `idleSeconds`) `held` (optional: the item in its hand, on the model's hand joint; the sword once it is an item, WORK_QUEUE item 35), `disposition` (`neutral`, the default: it starts no fight), `combat` (the hook when attacked: `none` or `fightBack`, it turns on its attacker) `colours` (per part, the palette ramp of its model's mesh it replaces, `from`, and the ramps one is picked from, `to`, seeded per NPC: the clothes) and `appearance` (optional, BUGS.md #152: its skin and hair, `set` a set of shared/creatures/appearance.json, `skin` and `hair` the model's part and ramp each recolours; seeded per NPC, a skin tone first, then a hair colour that goes with it, every skin vertex in the one tone) and `pattern` (optional, WORK_QUEUE item 43: the waist ring's and hat band's colours, `set` a set of shared/creatures/patterns.json, `places` the model's part for each place round the ring and the ramp the model paints it; seeded per NPC, a pattern by weight, then the clothes from its `pairs`). A rule's optional `spacingM` keeps a group that far from any other of its kind, and `biomes` (names in shared/worldgen/biomes) limits it to columns of those biomes (worlds with no biome map skip the check). The builder (`dwell:builder`, WORK_QUEUE item 56, docs/BLUEPRINTS.md) is the villager without its sword; it has no rule: the blueprints put one at a blueprint to build it. Only the deer (does, sometimes with a stag), the wolves and the villagers spawn for now (owner, 2026-11-10: "let's disable all the animals except wolves and deer for now"): the horse and the chicken are listed but have no rule. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/creatures/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/creatures.gen.rs is stale.
